name: ff-drift
description: Feature Flag Drift Checker - Compare config center, code defaults and env deploy values

scripts.example: tsx src/cli.ts diff --code examples/src/app --config examples/config/feature-flags.json --deploy examples/deploy/deployment-flags.yaml --owners examples/config/owners.json -e production
scripts.example:json: tsx src/cli.ts diff --code examples/src/app --config examples/config/feature-flags.json --deploy examples/deploy/deployment-flags.yaml --owners examples/config/owners.json -e production --format json
scripts.example:strict: tsx src/cli.ts diff --code examples/src/app --config examples/config/feature-flags.json --deploy examples/deploy/deployment-flags.yaml --owners examples/config/owners.json -e production --strict
